scope: Engineering presentation, full-frame delivery, amodal overlay placement and species-scoped pairing
engineering_observations: In this shallow-swim group the dark porpoise form was discernible within all five positive amodal rectangles and became smaller as GSD increased. This limited visual observation is not a visibility threshold or biological certification.

Larger original demonstration animals appeared in both positive and removed-target rows at 2, 3 and 4 cm/px. Negative labels refer only to the owned harbour-porpoise target; the imagery is not wildlife-free.
The two rows retained complete full frames at 50% scale. The five GSD captions and source seed/run/step/split were readable.
Gold rectangles represented direct amodal mesh boxes; this inspection did not establish exact visible or refracted underwater outlines.
